ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the M1-1,
Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District and C1-1, Neighborhood Commercial
District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 30-G and Map No. 30-F in the area
bound by:

a line 180 feet south of and parallel to West 120" Street; South Halsted Street; the south
right-of-way line of the Illinois Central Railroad; the alley next east of and parallel to
South Haisted Street; a line 175 feet south of and parallel to West 122" Street; South
Halsted Street; a line 247 feet north of and parallel to West 123” Street; the alley next
east of and parallel to South Halsted Street; West 1237 Street; the alley next west of and
parallel to South Halsted Street; a line 90 feet north of and paralle! to West 122"4 Street;
South Green Street; a line 275 feet north of and parallel to West 122 Street; the alley
next west of and parallel to South Halsted Street; the south right-of-way line of the Illinois
Central Railroad; South Peoria Street; the north right-of-way line of the Illinois Central
Railroad; a line 266.78 feet west of and parallel to South Halsted Street; a line 100 feet
north of and parallel to the north right-of-way line of the Illinois Central Railroad; and the
alley next west of and parallel to South Halsted Street,

to those of a B2-2, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.
